import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int add(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
        return a;
    }

    static long mul(long a, long b) {
        long res = a * b;
        if (res >= MOD) res %= MOD;
        return res;
    }

    static class Matrix<N, M> {
        int[][] data;

        Matrix() {
            data = new int[N][M];
        }

        void clear() {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(data[i], 0);
            }
        }

        void identity() {
            clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(N, M); i++) {
                data[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix<M, N> transpose() {
            Matrix<M, N> res = new Matrix<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = data[j][i];
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        int[] getRow(int idx) {
            return data[idx];
        }

        Matrix<N, M> add(Matrix<N, M> other) {
            Matrix<N, M> res = new Matrix<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = add(data[i][j], other.data[i][j]);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix<N, M> multiply(int scalar) {
            Matrix<N, M> res = new Matrix<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = (int) mul(data[i][j], scalar);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static <X> Matrix<Integer, Integer> multiply(Matrix<Integer, X> a, Matrix<X, Integer> b) {
        int N = a.data.length;
        int M = b.data[0].length;
        int X_dim = ((Matrix)a.data[0]).data.length;
        Matrix<Integer, Integer> res = new Matrix<>(N, M);
        res.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < X_dim; j++) {
                if (a.data[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < M; k++) {
                        res.data[i][k] = add(res.data[i][k], (int) mul(a.data[i][j], b.data[j][k]));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();

        // Initialize base matrices
        Matrix[][] base = new Matrix[65][35];
        Matrix[][] prefix = new Matrix[65][35];
        Matrix[][] suffix = new Matrix[65][35];

        for (int i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                base[i][j] = new Matrix<>(35, 35);
                prefix[i][j] = new Matrix<>(35, 35);
                suffix[i][j] = new Matrix<>(35, 35);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            base[0][i].identity();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                base[0][i].data[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        long block_size = K;
        for (int level = 1; block_size <= n; level++, block_size *= K) {
            suffix[level - 1][K - 1] = new Matrix<>(35, 35);
            for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                    suffix[level - 1][K - 1].data[i][j] = base[level - 1][K - 1].data[i][j];
                }
            }

            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                suffix[level - 1][j] = multiply(base[level - 1][j], suffix[level - 1][j + 1]);
            }

            prefix[level - 1][0] = new Matrix<>(35, 35);
            for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                    prefix[level - 1][0].data[i][j] = base[level - 1][0].data[i][j];
                }
            }

            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                prefix[level - 1][j] = multiply(prefix[level - 1][j - 1], base[level - 1][j]);
            }

            base[level][0] = new Matrix<>(35, 35);
            for (int i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                    base[level][0].data[i][j] = suffix[level - 1][0].data[i][j];
                }
            }

            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                base[level][j] = multiply(suffix[level - 1][j], prefix[level - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }

        long temp_n = n;
        while (temp_n > 0) {
            digits.add((int) (temp_n % K));
            temp_n /= K;
        }

        int carry = 0;
        Matrix<Integer, Integer> result = new Matrix<>(35, 35);
        result.identity();

        for (int i = digits.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digits.get(i); j++) {
                result = multiply(result, base[i][(j + carry) % K]);
            }
            carry = (carry + digits.get(i)) % K;
        }

        int answer = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            answer = add(answer, result.data[i][K]);
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
